title: Compliance Advisory Manager (1st line)
description:
About Griffin

Hi, we’re Griffin. We’re a fully regulated UK bank that powers the accounts and payments offerings of product-led fintechs and platforms like Uber, Yonder, Prosper, and Sidekick. By doing the heavy lifting behind the scenes, our customers can focus on what they do best - delivering amazing customer experiences.

We’ve grown rapidly since our launch in 2024, and today provide the banking backbone behind products in remittance, payroll, wealth, insurance, proptech, payments, neobanking and more.

We’re moving into card issuing, stablecoin infrastructure, and agentic finance next as we continue to support the next generation of product-led companies.

Learn more about what we do

Our culture

We believe that smart, motivated, conscientious people thrive in high-trust, high-autonomy environments and have done our best to create such an environment at Griffin. People who thrive here don’t require much hand-holding, and go out of their way to figure out how to contribute in the most valuable way possible.

We've been remote-first since we were established in 2017 and we remain so today. Work here is asynchronous and fully flexible - because we want to be a part of your life in a way that helps you to get the most out of both your work and home life.

We understand that our culture and ways of working aren’t for everyone, and we’re very intentional about our hiring process as a result. We won't hire people who don’t seem like a strong fit for our core values, even if they're otherwise extremely qualified.

Our strong culture has helped us to remain a mission-driven company as we have scaled, and gives our people a clear, explicit operating framework and the space to focus on delivering real value for our customers.

Learn more about our culture.

The Team

You'll join our Operational Controls team within the Service guild, the backbone of how Griffin stays compliant and keeps operational risk visible and manageable as we scale. Working closely with Protect (our second line) and across all operations functions, you'll be the first person dedicated to compliance within the team. You'll define what great compliance support looks like here, keeping Griffin's products and customer outcomes in shape as we grow.

The Service Guild at Griffin is the mindful engine room, driving our success. We strive to bring joy to our customers, both internal and external, through systems that just work.

There are four core elements to operations at Griffin: fincrime, payments, treasury ops and operational resilience. Across all teams, we place significant emphasis on compassion, ownership and curiosity. You will be empowered to make meaningful decisions and supported to make sure we collectively get those decisions right.

The opportunity

We want compliance built into how we design, sell and run our products. As our hands on compliance adviser in the first line (the teams who run the business and own its risks), you'll bring regulatory expertise to help our operations, commercial and product teams do exactly that. With card issuing and other launches coming up, there's plenty to get stuck into.

What success looks like

In your first year, our operations, sales and product teams bring you in early by default, because working with you makes things smoother, not slower. You've guided at least one major launch, like card issuing, from first idea to go live. Our live products have clear governance and outcome monitoring, and Protect (our second line risk and compliance team) sees fewer surprises and finds a stronger compliance foundation in place.

To do this you'll be involved in:

  • Product development: turning regulation into clear requirements, customer journeys, T&Cs and fair value assessments from first idea through product approval to launch.

  • Product lifecycle management: keeping live products compliant through periodic fair value assessments, outcome monitoring, reviews, changes and closures.

  • Sales: helping our commercial team check early whether potential partners fit our risk appetite, and reviewing sales material.

  • Marketing: working on both our marketing materials and ensuring that our customer's marketing materials are compliant with regulation and our own internal policies. Also ensuring that our own financial promotions are compliant and challenged appropriately.

  • Service (Operations): building regulatory requirements into how Service works day to day, with procedures and controls people actually use.

  • Regulatory change: working out what new rules mean for us, and making sure the right teams make the right changes on time.

  • Issues and reporting: investigating and fixing compliance issues, and reporting clearly on compliance risks and customer outcomes.

  • Working with second line (Protect): bringing them in early, sharing the evidence they need, and acting on their challenge.

We expect you to shape this role: This description reflects what we need today. How you achieve these outcomes, where you focus your energy, how this role evolves—that's for you to define as you learn what our customers need and where our technical gaps are.

Your background

To ensure this, we're looking for people who have:

  • Compliance experience in the first or second line of a UK regulated firm, ideally a bank, e-money institution or payments firm.

  • Practical knowledge of the rules behind our products, like Consumer Duty, BCOBS, CASS, FISMA, the Payment Services Regulations and the Money Laundering Regulations.

  • A hands on approach. You've turned regulation into practical requirements for product, sales or operations teams, and you're comfortable interpreting and applying FCA rules to new situations.

  • A curious, questioning approach. You know the right questions to ask before signing something off, not just the rules to check it against.

  • The confidence to challenge, clearly and kindly, when something isn't right.

  • A love of writing - we have a major amount of written documentation that you will be contributing to, and we place a high degree of importance on clarity and readability (you can find out more here about how we write).

Ideally, you would also:

  • Have deep expertise in at least one specialist area, such as payments, cards, Consumer Duty, BCOBS, financial promotions or similar.

  • Have worked in finance or Banking.

What can we offer you?

We are an early stage startup and we're working hard to expand our benefits package. We're planning to add to this list in the future.

  • Salary: £ 80-90 (DOE)

  • Remote-first flexibility: Work from anywhere in the UK

  • Work from abroad: Up to 20 days a year

  • Time off: 25 days’ holiday, bank holidays and a winter break (we shut down between Christmas and New Year)

  • Share options: Own a part of what we’re building together

  • Pension: Auto-enrolment into our Penfold scheme

  • Insurance: Private medical with Bupa (including family cover) and life insurance with AIG

  • Wellbeing: 1:1 coaching and therapy session available through Oliva

  • Family leave: Enhanced parental leave with up to 6 months on full pay after two years’ service

  • AI tools: Everyone has a Claude subscription on us and access to other premium tools

  • Your setup: We’ll support you in creating a comfortable and effective WFH environment.

As a bank, we’re committed to maintaining the highest standards of security. This means that the successful candidate will need to complete background screening, and our offer will be conditional upon satisfactory review of these checks. This would include verification of right to work, criminal record, credit history, social media and professional reference checks

How long will the process take?

We move as fast as possible, but it normally takes us about 2-3 weeks to get to know to each other.

  • Step 1: An initial phone call with our Talent Team for us to tell you more about Griffin and learn about your recent experience.

  • Step 2: Meet your manager to talk through your experience and how that relates to the requirements.

  • Step 3: A task based on what you’ll be doing on a day to day at Griffin.

  • Step 4: Meet with peers in your team for a more in-depth technical interview.

  • Step 5: Culture and Founder interview: Learn more about this here.

How do I apply?

Are we your next move? Apply via the link below, if there's a match our Talent team will reach out to schedule an initial conversation and talk you through what happens next.

We’re remote-first

We trust people to do great work wherever they are. We hire across the UK and most of our team works remotely full-time. We have a small London office in Moorgate for those who want it, and about a third of the company is close enough to use it occasionally, but there's no expectation to be there. What matters is the work, not where you do it.

Under representation

At Griffin, we’re looking for people who instinctively vibe with our values, behaviours and mission. You’re encouraged to apply, even if your experience doesn’t tick every box. Careers, like life, can take many twists and turns. Your technical expertise and path to where you are today will stand out. We're committed to creating a place where everyone belongs and we welcome diverse perspectives, backgrounds and people who are ready to build a global platform for programmable finance

title: Senior Electrical Characterisation Engineer
description:
About The Role and Team

Quantum Motion is a fast-growing quantum computing scale-up based in London founded by internationally renowned researchers from UCL and Oxford University with over 40 years’ experience in developing qubits and quantum computing architectures. Bringing together state-of-the-art cryogenic facilities and an outstanding interdisciplinary team, we are developing quantum processors based on industrial-grade silicon chips, with the potential to radically transform computing power in areas such as materials modelling, medicine, artificial intelligence and more.


Our Team


Since 2021 our team has been listed every year in the “Top 100 Startups worth watching” in the EE Times in 2021 and 2022, and our technology breakthroughs have been featured in The Telegraph, BBC and the New Statesman. Our founders are internationally renowned researchers from UCL and Oxford University who have pioneered the development of qubits and quantum computing architectures. Our chairman is the co-founder of Cadence and Synopsys, the two leading companies in the area of Electronic Design Automation. We’re backed by a team of top-tier investors, and we have recently closed our Series C funding of $160 million.

 

We bring together the brightest quantum engineers, integrated circuit (IC) engineers, quantum computing theoreticians and software engineers to create a unique, world-leading team, working together closely to maximise our combined expertise. Our collaborative and interdisciplinary culture is an ideal fit for anyone who thrives in a cutting-edge research and development environment focused on tackling big challenges and contributing to the development of scalable quantum computers based on silicon technology.

 

This is a rare and exciting opportunity to be an employee at a scale-up shaping the future of quantum computing. There are vast opportunities for professional growth and to make an impact within the company. 

Our team of 100+ is based across London, Oxford, San Sebastián and Sydney, with our primary hub in Islington (London).

We are looking for a Senior Electrical Characterisation Engineer to join our Process Integration team and play a key role in understanding, qualifying and improving the silicon devices at the heart of our quantum processors.

You will sit at a fascinating intersection between semiconductor manufacturing and quantum hardware, working closely with foundries, process engineers and quantum engineers.

You will use electrical characterisation and large-scale data analysis to understand manufacturing variability, identify the root causes of device behaviour, and feed those insights directly back into the semiconductor fabrication process.

This is an opportunity to have a tangible impact on the yield, quality and scalability of quantum processors, working with some of the most advanced silicon technology being developed for quantum computing.


Functions of the Role

  • Drive electrical characterisation of fabricated silicon devices, developing and continuously improving high-throughput screening methods to assess key device parameters including threshold voltage, gate oxide reliability and channel mobility.

  • Turn electrical data into manufacturing insight, identifying patterns, variability and device failures and connecting them back to semiconductor process steps such as photolithography, etching, oxide growth, CMP and doping.

  • Develop automated measurement and test infrastructure, creating robust Python-based test routines and instrument-control workflows across room-temperature and, where appropriate, low-temperature wafer probing environments.

  • Analyse large-scale electrical datasets using statistical process control, yield analysis and other data-driven techniques to monitor wafer uniformity, defect density and process drift.

  • Work directly with semiconductor foundries and process engineers, providing clear, actionable feedback that can be used to improve device performance, consistency and yield.

  • Build scalable characterisation processes, establishing testing standards, calibration procedures, SOPs and data pipelines that allow information to flow effectively between semiconductor process integration and quantum engineering teams.

  • Help shape how we characterise the next generation of our technology, bringing your expertise and ideas to continuously improve our measurement capability as Quantum Motion scales.

  • We are looking for someone who combines strong semiconductor device knowledge with a practical, data-driven approach to electrical characterisation.


Experience - Essentials


  • Master's or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Microelectronics, Semiconductor Physics, Materials Science or a closely related discipline.

  • 3+ years' experience in semiconductor device testing, reliability engineering, electrical characterisation or yield analysis within a foundry, IDM or semiconductor R&D environment.

  • Strong understanding of silicon CMOS fabrication processes, semiconductor device physics and foundry workflows.

  • Hands-on experience with semiconductor parameter analysers, SMUs and wafer probe stations, including DC and/or RF electrical testing.

  • Strong Python skills, particularly for instrument control, automation and automated test execution.

  • A highly analytical approach and the ability to work with large datasets to identify trends, anomalies and root causes.

  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across semiconductor, process, hardware and quantum engineering teams.


Experience - Desirable

It would be particularly valuable if you also have experience in:

  • Quantum device physics, including quantum dots, single-electron transistors (SETs) or charge-stability mapping.

  • Cryogenic electrical characterisation and low-temperature measurement systems.

  • Semiconductor yield improvement, process control or statistical analysis.

  • Automated wafer-level testing and high-throughput characterisation.

  • Working with advanced or emerging semiconductor technologies.


Benefits

  • Be part of a creative, world-leading team

  • Competitive salary and share options scheme

  • Contributory pension scheme

  • Group private medical insurance scheme

  • Life Assurance

  • Cycle-to-work Scheme 

  • Central London location

title: Account Executive - [UK&I]
description:
At Vanta, our mission is to help businesses earn and prove trust. We believe that security should be monitored and verified continuously, and we empower companies to practice better security and prove it with ease. Vanta has a kind and talented team, and while some have prior security experience, many have been successful at Vanta without it. 

As Vanta continues to grow, winning in the International markets will be critical. We’re just starting to establish our EMEA presence, and we need talented and customer focused Account Executives who are excited to help build and grow a large and untapped UK&I markets as we continue to distinguish Vanta as best-in-class to prospects in a burgeoning competitive landscape.

If this sounds like you, and you’re excited to be a part of our founding sales team in EMEA, we'd love to hear from you.

What you’ll do as an Account Executive at Vanta:

  • Own your pipeline from the ground up — identify, research, and prioritize high-potential accounts and verticals, building a consistent outbound motion to create new opportunities.

  • Run a world-class sales process — qualify deeply, forecast accurately, and progress deals using MEDDPICC or a similar structured methodology to drive predictable outcomes.

  • Convert interest into long-term value — educate prospects on the business impact of Vanta, deliver compelling demos, and tailor solution recommendations to each customer’s goals.

  • Communicate with executive presence — engage confidently with founders, CEOs, and technical leaders, translating complex compliance and security concepts into clear business value.

  • Continuously sharpen your craft — act on feedback, seek coaching, and contribute to improving team playbooks, messaging, and outbound best practices.

  • Be a self-starter who makes things happen — operate with urgency, ownership, and autonomy in a fast-moving environment where results matter.

  • Champion market expansion — explore partnership opportunities, represent Vanta at industry events, and help us deepen our presence in new and existing markets.

  • Cross-Functional — working alongside our SDR team, marketing team, legal and Solutions Engineers to find, run and win deals.

How to be successful in this role:

  • 3+ years closing experience

  • Have had a closing and quota-carrying role in the past, while consistently exceeding monthly and quarterly sales targets

  • Be experienced in B2B SaaS, preferably in SMB and Mid-Market

  • Be highly curious, seeking to understand customers, their needs and how best Vanta can help them

  • Possess the technical competency to understand Vanta’s software and build great relationships with highly technical prospects

  • Have stellar problem-solving skills, and an enthusiasm for making a large impact early on at a start-up

  • Have entrepreneurial spirit, initiative and autonomy so you can make a huge contribution to the EMEA landing team

  • Open to using AI to amplify their skills and strengthen their work - demonstrating curiosity, a willingness to learn, and sound judgment in applying AI responsibly to improve efficiency and impact.

What you can expect as a Vanta’n:

  • Industry-competitive salary and equity

  • 100% covered medical, dental, and vision benefits with dependents coverage

  • 16 weeks paid Parental Leave for all new parents Health & wellness stipend

  • Remote workspace, internet, and mobile phone stipend

  • Commuter benefits for team members who attend the office

  • Pension matching

  • 25 days of Annual Leave per year and unlimited sick time

  • 8 company-paid holidays

  • Virtual team building activities, lunch and learns, and other company-wide events!

  • Offices in SF, NYC, London, Dublin, Tel Aviv, and Sydney

#LI-hybrid

At Vanta, we are committed to hiring diverse talent of different backgrounds and as such, it is important to us to provide an inclusive work environment for all. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, gender identity, age, religion, sexual orientation, veteran or disability status, or any other protected class. As an equal opportunity employer, we encourage and welcome people of all backgrounds to apply.

About Vanta

We started in 2018, in the wake of several high-profile data breaches. Online security was only becoming more important, but we knew firsthand how hard it could be for fast-growing companies to invest the time and manpower it takes to build a solid security foundation. Vanta was inspired by a vision to restore trust in internet businesses by enabling companies to improve and prove their security. From our early days automating security monitoring for compliance standards like SOC 2, HIPAA and ISO 27001 to creating the world's leading Trust Management Platform, our vision remains unchanged. 

Now more than ever, making security continuous—not just a point-in-time check— is essential. Thousands of companies rely on Vanta to build, maintain and demonstrate their trust— all in a way that's real-time and transparent.

description:
Why Harvey

At Harvey, we’re transforming how legal and professional services operate. By combining frontier agentic AI, an enterprise-grade platform, and deep domain expertise, we’re reshaping how critical knowledge work gets done for decades to come.

This is a rare chance to help build a generational company at a true inflection point. We have strong product-market fit and world-class investor support. We’re scaling fast and defining a new category in real time. The work is ambitious, the bar is high, and the opportunity for growth — personal, professional, and financial — is unmatched.

Our team moves fast, takes ownership, and is deeply committed to the mission — operating with intensity, staying close to our customers, and pushing each other for excellence. We live by three values: Decisiveness, Simplicity, and Job's Not Finished. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you.

At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today — and we’re just getting started.

Role Overview

As one of Harvey’s founding SMB Account Executives, you'll play a pivotal role in driving growth within the legal and professional services markets. You will be responsible for establishing new business relationships with small law firms and in-house legal teams, deeply understanding their challenges, and delivering AI solutions that transform how they work. By combining a high-velocity sales motion with a consultative, solution-driven approach, you’ll set the foundation for how we win in SMB and create long term impact for our clients. We’re looking for someone who thrives in fast-paced, early-stage environments, is energized by building from scratch, and is passionate about bringing Harvey’s mission to life.

 

What You’ll Do

  • Own your book of business by prioritizing warm leads and a named account list to maintain a high velocity sales motion.

  • Manage the new business lifecycle from prospecting to qualifying, validating Harvey’s solution, and contracting.

  • Achieve and exceed revenue targets and other key sales metrics.

  • Build strong relationships with key decision-makers and stakeholders, understanding their pain points and aligning Harvey's solutions with their needs.

  • Conduct high velocity, tailored client evaluations, including product demonstrations and presentations.

  • Effectively work cross-functionally across the organization to shape Harvey’s solutions to meet SMB customer needs. Collaborate closely with the engineering and product teams to stay updated on the latest AI advancements and tailor solutions to meet client goals.

  • Proactively develop tactics, collateral, and messaging to improve the SMB team’s performance, documenting learnings that can be applied across accounts.

 

What You Have

  • Fluent in English and Portuguese; written and spoken

  • Proven track record of selling complex software solutions, with the ability to successfully execute on a consultative, solutions-oriented, value-based selling methodology at high velocity.

  • Capable of independently leading a sales cycle from start to finish

  • Ability to independently manage a pipeline, accurately forecast key sales performance metrics, and consistently maintain CRM hygiene

  • Ability to lead a multi-threaded sale with executive stakeholders – especially the ability to convey technical concepts to non-technical audiences.

  • Demonstrated passion for Harvey’s mission and strong understanding of AI and its potential applications in knowledge work. Interest in the legal profession and helping lawyers do their jobs better and more efficiently.

  • Team player who can collaborate effectively across internal functions (product, legal, etc.) to achieve common goals.

title: General Manager, Trainline Media
description:
About us

At Trainline, our purpose is to empower greener travel choices, connecting people and places. Trainline enables millions of travellers to find and book the best value tickets across carriers, fares, and journey options through our highly rated mobile app, website, and B2B partner channels. 

Great journeys start with Trainline 🚄 

We’re Europe’s leading independent rail platform, helping millions of travellers find and book the best-value rail and coach journeys across our app, website and partner channels.

Our job is to make the green travel choice the best choice. By building a better train travel experience, we help more people choose rail - creating a positive impact for customers, our business and the planet.

We’re a team of more than 1,000 Trainliners from over 50 nationalities, working across London, Paris, Barcelona, Milan, Edinburgh and Madrid. Now is a brilliant time to join us and help shape the future of travel.

Introducing the Trainline Media Team 👋

Trainline Media is an emerging part of Trainline's strategy, with real momentum behind it. The team brings together sales, advertising operations, client success and strategy, and is moving from an early pilot into its next phase of growth. It sits within a business where advertising is one part of a broader, operationally focused whole. This role suits someone who enjoys building: shaping team culture, defining how the function works and making thoughtful, steady progress.

As General Manager, Trainline Media, you will work closely with colleagues across the business, taking the time to understand how Trainline operates and aligning change with its wider priorities. In your first six to twelve months, you will help sharpen how Trainline Media presents itself to the market, focus the team on the right priorities and put in place the operational foundations needed to grow, balancing commercial growth with operational effectiveness.

In this role as the General Manager, Trainline Media, you will...🚄

  • Set the direction for Trainline Media, shaping its proposition, target market and growth priorities so it becomes a trusted travel media offering.

  • Take ownership of Trainline Media's revenue targets, working with senior stakeholders to align its goals with wider business priorities.

  • Partner with colleagues across Product, Data, PR and Marketing to develop the proposition and bring it to market.

  • Represent Trainline Media externally, building awareness and credibility with the media and advertising buying community through an active industry presence.

  • Lead and grow a team of more than ten people across sales, advertising operations, client success and strategy, creating a culture where people want to join and develop.

  • Design the operating model, processes and measures needed to scale the business, including client delivery and billing, using data and AI tools to help the team work smarter.

  • Balance commercial growth with operational effectiveness, so the function delivers sustainably as it grows.

We'd love to hear from you if you have...🔍

  • Experience building and scaling a media or advertising function, ideally within a larger, operationally focused consumer technology business.

  • A solid understanding of brand media, with the ability to position and grow an emerging proposition. Experience across performance media is also helpful if you have it.

  • Experience leading and growing large teams, and creating an environment where people can do their best work.

  • Experience owning revenue targets and designing the processes, operating rhythms and measures that support sustainable, scalable growth.

  • Sound judgement in balancing competing priorities, working constructively in a business where advertising is one of several revenue streams, and turning ambiguity into clear priorities and practical action.

  • A collaborative, diplomatic leadership style, with the ability to build trust and influence senior stakeholders.

  • Curiosity about how data and AI tools can improve the way a team works, and ideally some experience putting them to use.

  • An active presence in the media industry, or a keen interest in building one, and the confidence to represent the business externally.

More information:

Enjoy fantastic perks like private healthcare & dental insurance, a generous work from abroad policy, 2-for-1 share purchase plans, an EV Scheme to further reduce carbon emissions, extra festive time off, and excellent family-friendly benefits. 

We prioritise career growth with clear career paths, transparent pay bands, personal learning budgets, and regular learning days. Jump on board and supercharge your career from day one! 

We're operating a hybrid model and ask that Trainliners work from the office a minimum of 60% of their time over a 12-week period. We also have a 28-day Work from Abroad policy.

Our values represent the things that matter most to us and what we live and breathe everyday, in everything we do: 

  • 💭 Think Big - We're building the future of rail 

  • ✔️ Own It - We focus on every customer, partner and journey 

  • 🤝  Travel Together - We're one team 

  • ♻️ Do Good - We make a positive impact 

We know that having a diverse team makes us better and helps us succeed. And we mean all forms of diversity - gender, ethnicity, sexuality, disability, nationality and diversity of thought. That's why we're committed to creating inclusive places to work, where everyone belongs and differences are valued and celebrated.

title: Product Manager Intern - Connect
description:
About Mirakl:

Founded in 2012, Mirakl has been at the forefront of marketplace innovation, empowering every business to compete in the platform economy.

Today, Mirakl's operating system combines an enterprise marketplace solution (Mirakl Platform) that enables retailers and B2B organizations to launch, scale, and operate marketplaces and dropship, AI-powered multichannel selling (Mirakl Connect), retail media (Mirakl Ads) and an agentic commerce infrastructure (Mirakl Nexus).

With dual headquarters in Boston and Paris, Mirakl helps a global ecosystem of 450+ marketplaces (B2C and B2B) and a network of over 100k third-party marketplace sellers. Brands like Macy's, Decathlon, Carrefour, Asos, and Airbus Helicopters use Mirakl to grow their businesses in new and remarkable ways.

For more information: www.mirakl.com.

Mirakl in Numbers:

  • 🗓️ Founded in 2012 | Member of French Tech Next40
  • 👥 750+ employees in 9 offices worldwide: Paris, Barcelona, Bordeaux, Boston, London, Munich, New York, Sydney, Tokyo
  • 🇫🇷 350+ Mirakl Tech teams members mainly based in France
  • ⚙️ 5 Saas Solutions

Our Values:

Working at Mirakl means accelerating your career alongside ambitious, passionate, and supportive colleagues. We're proud of the diversity of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences that make our teams unique.

Our 5 values guide how we collaborate:

  • 💡 Work Hard Together: Teamwork and collaboration are the foundation of our success
  • 🏆 Get Things Done:  We prioritize action and efficiency for impactful results
  • 🚀 Go Above & Beyond:  We tackle challenges proactively and always aim for excellence
  • 🎓 Succeed Through Expertise: Knowledge sharing and continuous learning are core to our culture
  • 🤝 Satisfy & Empower Clients: We're committed to our clients' success

The Team You'll Join

You'll join the Product team of Mirakl Connect, the platform that helps brands and sellers grow their sales across marketplaces and other sales channels. You'll work closely with the VP Product Connect, the Channel Integration PM and the whole Channel Integration squad.

This is a 6-month internship starting in January 2027. You'll participate in team rituals, gain autonomy progressively, and have the opportunity to present your work regularly to management, offering strong visibility within the organization.


Your Impact

Choosing and building the right channels is one of our biggest growth levers. As a Product Manager Intern, your mission will be to help the team prepare and assess new channel opportunities, reduce uncertainty before development starts and contribute to successful integrations.

Your work will help the squad bring together the key information, questions, risks and opportunities before development begins.

Concretely, you will:

  • Help pre-qualify channels: Map the marketplace landscape by country and vertical, and contribute to a first-level assessment of each channel: technical integration effort, functional coverage with Mirakl Connect, and business potential (seller demand).
  • Explore channel requirements: Review channel API specifications and requirements across catalog, offers, orders and logistics, and test them hands-on (e.g. with Postman). With support from the team, identify key questions, dependencies, risks and areas that require further investigation.
  • Prepare build-ready inputs: Turn your analyses into useful inputs for the squad, such as data mappings, process diagrams, edge cases, open questions for channel partners and first drafts of user stories."
  • Talk to the field: Interview sellers, Sales and Customer Success teams, and channel partner teams to turn scattered feedback into clear insights and product recommendations.
  • Contribute to channel builds: Alongside the Channel Integration PM and the squad, help refine specifications and user stories, contribute to backlog discussions, answer functional questions and participate in QA and go-live preparation.
  • Build AI-powered tools to scale channel work: Use AI tools to accelerate research, analysis and prototyping. For example, you may help create an agent that analyzes channel documentation, a Q&A assistant for Sales and Customer Success or AI-assisted prototypes to explore mappings and integration flows.

What Success Looks Like

  • After 3 months: A broad set of channels pre-analyzed at a high level, with a first assessment of technical integration effort and functional coverage, contributing to channel pre-qualification
  • After 6 months: Several channels analyzed in depth and handed over to the squad as build-ready, an active contribution to channel builds, and at least one AI tool in daily use by the team


What You'll Bring to the Role

Profile & Experience

  • Currently pursuing a gap year internship or end-of-studies internship (engineering school, business school or university)
  • Strong interest in e-commerce, marketplaces and retail
  • A structured mindset, with the ability to turn a broad or ambiguous question into a clear and actionable analysis
  • A genuine curiosity for understanding how products, processes and systems work
  • Previous experience in a start-up or scale up, in e-commerce, consulting, business analysis or project work is a plus, but not required


Technical Skills

  • Hands-on with APIs: You understand what an API is and how systems exchange data, and you can read API documentation and make simple API calls (e.g. with Postman). Familiarity with data formats (JSON, XML) or integration concepts is a plus.
  • Data and spreadsheet skills: You are comfortable using spreadsheets to analyze, compare and synthesize information. Experience with dashboards or SQL would be a plus.
  • Hands-on with AI tools: You use AI tools daily and critically to improve research, analysis and product work. Experience creating prompts, automations or agents is a plus.

Soft Skills

  • Curious, proactive and rigorous: You take initiative, ask thoughtful questions and dig until the key unknowns are clarified.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills: You communicate clearly with different stakeholders, collaborate effectively in cross-functional environments and can summarize complex information into clear, actionable conclusions for different audiences.
  • Fast learner with adaptability: You pick up new domains quickly and are comfortable learning unfamiliar concepts.
  • Critical thinker: You can challenge assumptions, assess the quality of information and distinguish facts from hypotheses.


Languages

  • Fluent English is mandatory, both written and spoken, as it is our working language with the team and channel partners.
  • Another European language is a plus.

Compensation

Monthly stipend range: €1,200 - €1,400


Our Hiring Process

We warmly encourage you to apply to this role, even if you think you're not an exact match.

Please click the "Apply" button to submit your application. This helps us make the best possible assessment and get back to you as quickly as possible.

  1. Manual screening of your CV by a recruiter and then an AI-powered screening conversation (10 min) with Emma, Mirakl's AI Talent Ambassador to explore your background and motivation for the role. You will need to complete this step within 3 days, otherwise we won't be able to move forward with your application
  2. TA interview (30-45 minutes) to discuss your experience and answer your questions about Mirakl
  3. Hiring Manager interview (45 minutes) with one of the Product Managers to dive deeper into the role and assess technical fit
  4. STAR interview (45 minutes) to evaluate alignment with our values and team culture
  5. Offer

We welcome collaborators with their diverse perspectives and experiences to power us forward. These often far exceed conventional job requirements and help us create a culture of continuous learning. If you're ready to join a global leader powering digital transformation for 450+ of the world's most innovative retailers and B2B organizations.

title: Junior Product Owner
description:

ROMEO is the queer company behind the legendary ROMEO dating app, one of Europe’s longest-standing dating platforms for queer communities. We are looking for a Product Owner to join our Product team in Berlin and help shape how ideas and product requirements make their way into the hands of millions of users.

In this delivery-focused role, you will work closely with Product Management, Design, Engineering, QA and BI to turn product priorities into clear, actionable work for our development teams. It is a great opportunity to grow your product skills while taking real ownership of the day-to-day delivery process.


Your typical day

  • Support the Product Management team in refining product requirements and translating approved PRDs into implementation-ready epics, user stories and tickets.
  • Ensure user stories have clear acceptance criteria and are sufficiently refined before entering development.
  • Maintain and order the backlog according to priorities set by product leadership.
  • Take part in regular and ad hoc meetings to clarify product requirements with development, design and other delivery teams.
  • Support our two-week delivery cycle by ensuring development teams have the information and decisions they need to proceed.
  • Identify missing requirements, dependencies, open decisions and blockers early, and escalate them to Product or Delivery.
  • Work closely with QA to communicate product and release priorities, clarify acceptance criteria, and support defect triage and release-readiness decisions.
  • Support product acceptance and release readiness by checking delivered functionality against agreed requirements and acceptance criteria.
  • Support the BI team by translating product questions, KPIs and tracking needs into clear data requirements.
  • Ensure agreed analytics requirements are captured as part of delivery, including relevant event tracking before work is considered complete.
  • Maintain clear and up-to-date product documentation in Jira and Confluence.

  • You are passionate about building products for LGBTQ+ communities and interested in contributing to the continued development of ROMEO.
  • You have initial experience in a Product Owner or similar product delivery role, ideally in a B2C environment. Experience in social, dating or community products is a plus. Being familiar with how our product works is a plus.
  • You have experience writing or refining user stories and acceptance criteria.
  • You have a good understanding of Agile product development and ideally hands-on experience with Scrum and/or Kanban.
  • You are comfortable working with Jira and Confluence. Experience with Xray is a plus.
  • You are organised, detail-oriented and reliable in following work through to completion.
  • You proactively follow up on missing information and drive requirements towards clarity.
  • You are based in Berlin or willing to relocate and are happy to work from our Wittenbergplatz office at least three days per week.

  • A hands-on role working on an established European digital product during a significant phase of product and technology transformation.
  • Close collaboration with Product, Design, Engineering, QA and BI,
  • Hybrid working (3 days per week in our Berlin office at Wittenbergplatz)

title: Chief of Staff to the CTO - Engineering
description:
Are you looking to have an impact on the daily life of millions of entrepreneurs in France (and tomorrow in Europe)?

Are you looking for a work environment that values trust, proactivity, and autonomy?

Then Pennylane is the right place for you !

 

Our vision

We aim to become the most beloved financial Operating System of French SMEs and Accounting Firms (and soon, European ones).

We help entrepreneurs rid themselves of time-consuming tasks related to accounting and finance while providing them with access to key financial information to assist in making the best decisions for their business.

 

About us

Pennylane is one of the fastest growing Fintechs in France (and soon to be in Europe!)

 

In 5 years of existence, we’ve managed to :

💻 Make ourselves known as a groundbreaking accounting and financial software for small businesses and their accountants

💰 Raise a total of €400 millions, including from Sequoia, the famous fund from the Silicon Valley who invested early in companies like Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal and much more...

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Grow from 7 cofounders to 1000 happy Pennylaners : we’re now recognized as one of the greatest places to work in France (and also remotely), with a 4.6/5 rating on Glassdoor.

🌍 Build an international environment with more than 25 nationalities, with a strong remote-friendly culture, where 30% of the employees are already working from all parts of Europe

🤝 Earn the trust of thousands of customers and accounting firms and obtain outstanding ratings

🚀 Already more than 900,000 small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) and over 6000 accounting firms use Pennylane in France!

 

In 2024, we implemented an organizational structure built around business 'tracks'. This approach integrates key stakeholders across marketing, sales, product, and customer care into unified teams focused on specific product lines or client segments. Each track operates as a mini-business, empowered with dedicated resources (e.g., product marketing, data analytics, and operational support) and direct accountability for performance.

 
 

Why this role matters at Pennylane

 

As Chief of Staff to the CTO, you operate as a senior leader in the Tech organisation. Your leverage does not come from managing teams but from owning the hardest problems that sit between them, and from being technical enough to earn the trust of the other engineering leaders.

You are the person the CTO trusts with ambiguous, org-wide problems. You turn that ambiguity into a clear framing, a decision, an owner and a measurable outcome.

This is not a coordination role. You are expected to have opinions on engineering strategy, staffing choices and technical trade-offs, and to defend them in front of the Tech leadership team.

 

Team and Context

Pennylane's Tech organisation is 70+ squads, each led by an Engineering Manager working with a PM and a Product Designer. We serve 1.5m+ customers and we want to scale in Europe. At that size, the hard problems are no longer inside a squad: how the organisation plans, how it decides, how it measures itself, how it invests in foundations without stalling product delivery. That is your perimeter.

You report directly to Quentin, Co-founder & CTO. Your influence comes from the scope of what you own and from credibility with senior engineering leaders, which is why we ask for a technical background. As the organisation grows, this role can evolve towards a management position.

Key missions

Engineering strategy and transversal initiatives

  • Own the strategic, cross-organization initiatives that no single squad can carry: platform or architecture programmes, reliability and quality step-changes, engineering productivity, technical debt paydown

  • Frame the problem, build the technical and business case, secure alignment across Engineering, Product and Security to drive execution

  • Lead the Tech side of company-level programmes (e.g. European expansion, major compliance or infrastructure shifts) alongside the rest of the Tech leadership

Planning & Performance tracking

  • Own the Tech planning cycle: collect the inputs, surface the trade-offs (capacity vs. platform, run vs. new bets), and drive the arbitration with Tech leadership

  • Drive the definition and calibration of Tech OKRs, and hold the organisation accountable

  • Define what "good" looks like for a 70+ squad engineering organization and build the metrics that measure it (delivery cadence, reliability, quality, staffing and attrition, engineering satisfaction)

Decision-making and leadership cadence

  • Own the Tech leadership operating system: staff meetings, QBRs, roadmap and architecture reviews. You design them, set the agenda, write or commission the pre-reads, frame the decisions to be made, and make sure decisions land

  • Maintain the CTO's decision log: what was decided, by whom, with what trade-off, and what happened next

  • Raise the quality of decision-making across the Tech leadership team

Communication

  • Lead internal and operational communications across the engineering organization, building clear messaging systems from board decks down to team-wide updates

Who you’ll work with?

  • CTO and Tech leadership (Head of Engineering / Head of Data / Senior Engineering Managers)

  • Rest of the leadership (CPO, VP Strategic Initiatives)

  • Other relevant teams (e.g. Security, Finance, People)

Who we’re looking for

Must-have

  • An engineering degree (engineering, computer science or equivalent scientific curriculum)

  • Technical fluency: you can read a design doc, follow an architecture discussion, challenge an estimate or a trade-off, and be taken seriously by senior engineers

  • 7-10 years of experience, including significant time inside a tech organisation at scale (multiple squads, platform teams), where you have lived the problems of scaling engineering

  • A track record of owning complex, cross-organisational initiatives from framing to measurable outcome with senior stakeholders

  • Outstanding written communication: this role produces documents that senior people act on

  • Fluency in English

Nice-to-have

  • A hands-on engineering past: software engineer, engineering manager, Technical Program Manager, architect or equivalent

  • Experience as a Chief of Staff, VP/Director of Engineering Operations, or in a strategy & operations function inside a product-led tech company

What you can expect?

Within one month

  • You'll complete the company and Tech onboarding, including our application, accounting domain and engineering practices

  • You'll have met the Tech leadership team and formed your own view of where the organisation loses time, quality or alignment

  • You'll have taken ownership of the leadership cadence and the next planning milestone

Within 3-6 months

  • You'll be leading selected org-wide strategic initiatives end-to-end, with a measurable target

  • The Tech organisation will have a metrics picture it trusts and uses to make decisions

  • You'll be a recognised voice in the senior tech community at Pennylane, consulted on decisions rather than just informed of them

  • You'll be shaping the engineering narrative that the rest of the company and the board hear

Recruitment Process

- Screening interview with Barbara - Senior Recruiter (30 mins)

- An interview with Eric - VP Strategic Initiatives (1h)

- A Business Case to prepare at home and to present (1h)

- A final interview with Quentin - CTO (45 mins)

What do we do to make your work life easier

 

🌴 Wherever you are based, you will get 25 vacations days paid by Pennylane

💵 You’ll have a competitive compensation package

📈 You'll get company shares to enjoy a piece of the success story you're building with us

🏡 You’ll have a budget to turn your home into a more comfortable workspace, as well as a monthly allowance to work from a coworking space whenever you feel like it

⛹️ Through our partner Gymlib, you’ll have access to 8000 fitness spaces in Europe and more than 300 activities related to wellness

🇬🇧 You’ll have access to Busuu to perfect your English or your French

💻 You’ll get the latest Apple equipment

🏢 Depending on the teams and the requirements of the position - you'll be able to work remotely from your country of residence, as long as it is in Europe and within a maximum time difference of two hours from the CET time zone

🎉 We are committed to regularly coming together for company events such as Tech Days (which bring remote Pennylaners together every 3 months) or our annual company seminar, fostering significant moments of cohesion for everyone.

 

If you are based in France, you will have a French contract following French regulation on top of the additional perks : 6 to 12 RTT, 5 weeks PTOs, lunch credits (Swile), Alan Blue healthcare cover and regular events in cities where Pennylaners are mostly presents (Lyon, Bordeaux, Nantes…)

We're working on providing those last advantages to our people based outside of France as well, but it can be quite more complex depending on different countries.

 

Who are we looking for ?

To thrive at Pennylane, you need :

-To speak English (level is assessed and appreciated according to the department you’re applying to)

-To be energized by an ever-shifting work environment

-To be highly collaborative (within your team or other stakeholders)

-Sufficiently experienced to prioritize business-led actions on your day to day activity

 

We know that some people are less likely to apply than others, if they don’t feel like they meet the full list of criteria.

If you’re hesitating, we encourage you to apply : who knows, it might be the start of a meaningful and long-lasting collaboration.

 

Important information for candidates

Recruitment scam attempts are on the rise. We invite you to remain vigilant during your exchanges.

Applications through official channels only : apply exclusively through our job postings published on our official platforms (career site, official partner pages).

Always verify the sender's email address: our communications are sent from professional email addresses with the domains ----- or ----- style="min-height:1.5em">We will never ask you for payment or financial information

(bank details, payment for an interview, equipment purchases, etc.) as part of the recruitment process. If such a request is made to you, it is fraudulent. We invite you to not respond and to report it to us immediately.

 

We also want to emphasize that we fully embrace diversity, equity and inclusion and that we’re doing our best to create a safe and inclusive environment.

We are committed to providing an equal employment opportunity regardless of gender, sexual orientation, origin, disabilities, or any other traits that make you who you are. If anything, diversity makes us a more fun place to work at.

title: Sales Development Representative (SDR) - Scale up Healthtech
description:
Chez Lifen, nous pensons que les données médicales ont le potentiel de transformer le système de santé. Mais seulement si elles sont accessibles. Plus de données accessibles → moins de charge administrative, une meilleure coordination des soins et des découvertes scientifiques plus rapides.

Depuis 2015, notre mission est de libérer ce potentiel. Nos solutions basées sur l'IA permettent aux professionnels de santé de partager les informations médicales sans effort et aux chercheurs d'accélérer les découvertes cliniques : avec un impact sur des millions de patients en France chaque jour. Alors que nous nous préparons à nous développer en Europe, 2 choses déterminent notre succès : nos équipes et notre mission.

Aujourd'hui, plus de 150 personnes travaillent depuis nos bureaux et à distance pour libérer le potentiel des données de santé. Nous avons connecté 800 hôpitaux et 150 000 professionnels de santé, et nous ne faisons que commencer. Nous recherchons des personnes qui embrassent la complexité, veulent résoudre des problèmes difficiles et sont prêtes à construire le futur de la collaboration en santé.

⚡ Notre équipe Sales Public

L’équipe Sales Public accompagne les établissements de santé dans l’adoption des solutions Lifen, principalement autour de la gestion des documents de santé. Elle compte aujourd’hui 8 Sales Account Executives qui travaillent sur l’ensemble du territoire.

Les Sales concentrent aujourd’hui leur temps sur les plus grands établissements et groupements hospitaliers. À côté, il existe un vivier d’environ 800 structures de santé de plus petite taille. Leur potentiel est réel, mais le CRM est encore peu qualifié et les bons interlocuteurs restent souvent à identifier.

Nous créons donc notre premier poste de SDR Public. Ton rôle sera de construire ce périmètre : mieux connaître ces structures, trouver les personnes à contacter, qualifier les opportunités et transmettre aux Sales des rendez-vous réellement exploitables. Tu travailleras principalement sur nos offres Lifen Documents et Curecall by Lifen.

🎯 Ce que tu feras chez nous

  • Cartographier et prioriser un portefeuille d’environ 800 petites structures de santé, en partant d’une base CRM encore largement à enrichir.

  • Identifier les bons interlocuteurs au sein de ces établissements, en mobilisant les informations disponibles sur Internet, LinkedIn, le téléphone et les autres canaux de prospection.

  • Entrer en contact avec les prospects, comprendre leur contexte et qualifier les opportunités avant de proposer un échange avec un ou une Sales Account Executive.

  • Générer des rendez-vous qualifiés pour l’équipe Sales, en transmettant les informations utiles pour permettre une prise de relais efficace.

  • Mettre à jour le CRM avec rigueur : contacts, informations sur les structures, niveau de maturité des opportunités et prochaines étapes.

  • Faire progresser les méthodes de prospection sur ce nouveau périmètre : messages, séquences, critères de qualification et priorisation des comptes.

⭐️ Ce que nous recherchons

Must-have

  • Une première expérience commerciale (Stage, Alternance ou CDI), idéalement d’un à deux ans en startup, en SDR, Inside Sales, prospection B2B ou relation client.

  • Une vraie appétence pour la prospection : prendre contact, obtenir les bonnes informations, relancer et transformer une approche en rendez-vous qualifié.

  • La capacité à organiser un volume important de comptes, à prioriser et à tenir un suivi précis dans un CRM.

  • Une communication orale et écrite claire, adaptée à des interlocuteurs de direction de structures de santé.

Nice-to-have

  • Une expérience dans la santé ou auprès de professionnels et d’établissements de santé.

  • Une première expérience dans un environnement startup ou scale-up.

  • La pratique d’outils de CRM et de prospection.

Soft skills

Tu es énergique et tu aimes avancer sur un périmètre à construire. Face à une base peu qualifiée, tu sais chercher, trier l’information et décider par où commencer, sans te disperser. Tu communiques simplement, tu écoutes avant de proposer un rendez-vous et tu acceptes les retours pour ajuster ta manière de faire. L’humilité compte : tu travailleras avec une équipe Sales expérimentée et tu sauras apprendre à ses côtés tout en apportant tes propres observations du terrain.

Nos valeurs

Embrace Complexity. Tu avances dans un secteur de santé complexe et sur un portefeuille encore peu structuré, en transformant progressivement des informations éparses en opportunités qualifiées.

Bienveillance. Tu collabores étroitement avec les Sales, dans une équipe où l’entraide et le partage d’informations font partie du quotidien.

Real Impact. Chaque rendez-vous qualifié peut contribuer à équiper davantage de structures de santé avec des outils qui simplifient la circulation des documents.

👥 Process de recrutement

Le process est volontairement court et se déroulera principalement en visio.

  1. TAM Screening avec l’équipe recrutement - Environ 30 minutes. L’objectif est de comprendre ton parcours, ta motivation pour le poste et d’évaluer les fondamentaux attendus : communication, énergie, organisation et posture commerciale.

  2. Case study avec l’équipe Sales - Un entretien en visio d’1h comprenant la restitution de trois exercices : deux préparés à l’avance et un exercice réalisé en direct. Le cas sera envoyé environ deux jours avant l’échange et demandera environ 1h30 à 2h de préparation. Il permettra d’évaluer ta capacité à qualifier un compte, à prioriser, à structurer une approche de prospection et à communiquer avec clarté.

  3. Final Interview - Un entretien avec un Manager de l’équipe Sales pour valider l’alignement culturel.

Nous nous engageons à te donner de la visibilité tout au long du process et à revenir vers toi sous 72h après chaque étape. Des prises de références pourront être demandées en fin de process, avec ton accord.

Soigner mieux en soignant ensemble, c'est aussi agir avec bienveillance. À l'image du secteur dans lequel nous évoluons, nous favorisons la diversité, l'inclusion et l'équité. Nous mettons en valeur vos compétences et votre savoir-faire, et bannissons toute forme de discrimination, qu'elle soit sexuelle, religieuse ou politique.

description:
🏨 The Company

Resilience Care, a leading player in remote medical monitoring and a partner in clinical research, is a French company founded in 2021 with a single mission: to provide better care.

Our company offers remote monitoring solutions in oncology, gastroenterology, and psychiatry, based on the collection of ePROs combined with AI technologies. These solutions rely on a monitoring platform for healthcare professionals—enabling the early detection of side effects for continuous and proactive care—and a mobile app for patients, empowering them to measure and manage their symptoms using tailored resources.

Our solutions optimize patient care, continuously enrich our understanding of patients throughout their healthcare journey, and accelerate clinical research through the collection, structuring, and in-depth analysis of real-world data. Today, our solutions are deployed in routine care for 35,000 patients across more than 200 healthcare facilities, as well as within the framework of around twenty academic and industrial clinical trials.

description:
Venez rejoindre l'IMT Mines Alès, grande école de prestige qui se classe parmi les meilleures écoles d’ingénieurs sur le plan national et mondial et implantée à Alès, ville à taille humaine, capitale des Cévennes où la qualité de vie est fortement appréciée par ses habitants.

Créée en 1843, IMT Mines Alès compte à ce jour 1400 élèves (dont 250 étrangers) et 380 personnels. L’école dispose de 3 centres de recherche et d’enseignement de haut niveau scientifique et technologique, qui œuvrent dans les domaines des matériaux et du génie civil (C2MA), de l’environnement et des risques (CREER), de l’intelligence artificielle et du génie industriel et numérique (CERIS). Elle dispose de 12 plateformes technologiques et compte 1600 entreprises partenaires. Pour en savoir plus : https://www.imt-mines-ales.fr

Vous êtes rattaché(e) au Centre de Recherche et d’Enseignement en Environnement et Risques (CREER) de l'IMT Mines Alès et dans l'unité de recherche : HSM.

Ce travail s’inscrit dans le cadre du projet PREV’IA qui s’intéresse à la connaissance et à la prévision des ressources en eaux de la nappe plioquaternaire de la plaine de Roussillon, et de la source du Lez qui alimente Montpellier en eau potable.

Votre travail s’inscrira dans la continuité d’une thèse en cours au sein de l’UMR HSM (équipe HYTAKE), portant sur la durabilité de la ressource en eau karstique (aquifère du Lez) alimentant une métropole méditerranéenne (Montpellier) en contexte de changement climatique.

 

Votre mission :

  • Utiliser les concepts émergeants dans les approches de « Physics Informed Machine Learning » (PIML) pour évaluer les intérêts d’une synergie en modélisation hydrogéologique : (1) à base conceptuelle d’une part et (2) à base de réseaux de neurones informés, ou complémentés, par la physique. L’approche PIML (Physics Informed Machine Learning) est développée, avec deux courants : (i) les Physics Informed Architecture (PIA) : intégration de connaissances physiques dans l’architecture du modèle (couches cachées) ; et (ii) les Physics Informed Loss Function (PILF) : combinaison de modélisations physiques (équations différentielles) et boîte noire, fusionnées dans la fonction de coût (terme de régularisation). Les deux méthodes pourront être explorées. Les modèles proposés pourront être utilisés pour déterminer l’évolution de certaines grandeurs hydrologiques en réponse au changement climatique.

Vous trouvez plus d’information sur le descriptif du poste ci-dessous :

https://partage.imt.fr/index.php/s/ANqeAPRfSdBfnof

  • Doctorat dans un des domaines liés à l’hydrogéologie, l’hydrologie, ou la modélisation de l’environnement

Compétences, connaissances et expériences requises :

  • Expérience en machine Learning pour la modélisation des phénomènes naturels complexes

  • Valorisation des compétences dans le cadre de projet(s) pluridisciplinaire(s)

  • Réelles aptitudes et une expérience en organisation et travail en équipe : organisation de réunions, planification des actions, contribution à la rédaction de documents administratifs

  • Bonne pratique de l’anglais scientifique

title: Maître de conférences en Cybersécurité
description:
IMT Atlantique, reconnue internationalement pour la qualité de sa recherche, est une école d’ingénieurs de premier plan sous la tutelle du ministère de l'industrie et du numérique, classée dans les trois principaux classements internationaux (THE, SHANGHAI, QS).

 

Le poste est ouvert sur le campus de Rennes au sein du département SRCD (Systèmes Réseaux, Cybersécurité et Droit du numérique). Le département SRCD est composé de 24 enseignant.e.s-chercheurs.euses permanent.e.s, plus de 10 post-doctorant.e.s et ingénieur.e.s contractuel.le.s, et 30 doctorant.e.s. Ses domaines d'activité recouvrent tous les aspects de l'enseignement et de la recherche en systèmes et réseaux au sens large, en cybersécurité, et en droit et économie des activités numériques. Dans le cadre de ses activités de recherche, la personne recrutée rejoindra l’équipe SOTERN (Self Protecting the Future Internet) du département D2 du laboratoire IRISA (UMR CNRS 6074), l'un des plus grands laboratoires de recherche français (+ de 850 personnes) dans le domaine de l'informatique et des nouvelles technologies de l'information.

Enjeux et profil attendu sur le thématique de recherche

 

Deux enjeux majeurs présentent actuellement un impact conséquent sur la recherche et l’innovation en Cybersécurité. D’un côté, l’intelligence artificielle par ses développements récents et les attendus pour les années à venir décuple les possibilités offertes aux attaquants pour mettre en œuvre de nouvelles attaques, tout autant qu’aux structures défensives (type SOC par exemple) pour détecter, corréler et contrer des incidents de sécurité. D’un autre côté, les cibles des attaques évoluent et les architectures déployées dans les réseaux opérationnels (systèmes industriels, réseaux intra-véhiculaires, avionique, opérateurs d’importance vitale) nécessitent de nouveaux moyens de détection et protection face à une menace grandissante.

Le profil recherché pour ce poste s’inscrit ainsi dans la thématique de la sécurité des réseaux au sens large. Il sera plus spécifiquement recherché soit une expertise relative aux architectures, protocoles et algorithmes d’intelligence artificielle pour la sécurité des réseaux ou de l’IA (apprentissage fédéré, sécurité des architectures d’IA type Model Context Protocol (MCP), etc.), soit une expertise sur la sécurité des réseaux opérationnels (OT) quel qu’en soit le cadre applicatif.  

 

Enjeux et profil attendu en enseignement

 

Positionnée sur 3 campus attractifs, IMT Atlantique affiche une forte dynamique internationale tout en restant à taille humaine. Dans ces différents cursus BAC+5 (formations d’ingénieurs et de masters-DNM), les étudiants sont confrontés, via des approches pédagogiques variées, à des situations-problèmes concrets. L’école a ainsi pour ambition de former de jeunes professionnels à fort potentiel, capables de mobiliser un large spectre de compétences en situation réelle, dans des environnements (production, recherche, création d’activité, etc.) et des domaines socio-économiques variés.

 

Impliqué tant en tronc commun que dans les parcours électifs, la personne recrutée contribuera aussi bien dans sa spécialité Cybersécurité que dans des activités transverses, interdisciplinaires ou en lien avec des entreprises : tutorat de projets / stages, soutenances, accompagnement, etc. La personne recrutée sera encouragée à contribuer, dans un esprit de collaboration, à l’évolution cohérente des programmes d’études, en proposant de nouveaux projets, programmes et méthodologies pédagogiques, particulièrement inspirés et soutenus par les exigences et les partenariats industriels. https://www.imt-atlantique.fr/fr/formation

 

En cohérence avec le profil de la personne candidate, il sera demandé de prendre en main les thématiques d’enseignement parmi les suivantes : IA et Cybersécurité (IA offensive, IA pour la protection des infrastructures, sécurité de l’IA), Sécurité des systèmes industriels, participation puis prise de responsabilité de l’organisation du CTF Hack’lantique, et plus largement une participation aux différents enseignements en Cybersécurité.

 

Responsabilité collective et implication dans le développement économique

En effet une attention particulière sera portée sur la capacité du candidat à s’impliquer dans la vie collective de l’école : contribuer, ou piloter des projets transverses (par exemple sur la transition écologique, prendre des responsabilités (programmes de formation, projets de recherche, équipes pédagogiques ou de recherche) ou participer à des instances : comité de l’enseignement, conseil d’école, comité social d’administration.

En outre dans un environnement de relations privilégiées avec de grands partenaires industriels nationaux et internationaux, ainsi qu’un réseau dense de PME, Start up, l’enseignant chercheur recruté contribuera au rayonnement de l’école et au développement économique, notamment au travers de la valorisation de ses travaux par le dépôt de brevet ou le transfert de technologies. Avec 257 enseignants-chercheurs permanents, 2450 étudiants dont 399 doctorants, IMT Atlantique produit chaque année 655 publications et lève 28.3M€ de fonds de recherche.

title: Professeur(e) en Data/IA appliquée aux Matériaux et Procédés Rattaché(e) au Centre Institut Clément Ader Albi (ICA-A)
description:
ENVIRONNEMENT DU POSTE :

École du ministère en charge de l’industrie, IMT Mines Albi est une école de l’Institut Mines-Télécom (IMT), 1er groupe d’écoles d’ingénieurs et de management de France. À l’avant-garde des enjeux industriels et académiques sur la scène internationale, elle agit comme un moteur scientifique et économique territorial en combinant ses quatre missions : former des ingénieurs en intégrant la dynamique du développement durable, faire de la recherche scientifique, contribuer au développement économique et diffuser la culture des sciences, des techniques et de l’innovation, en un cercle vertueux et porteur d’innovation.

Son positionnement en matière de formation et de recherche place IMT Mines Albi comme une école de référence sur trois des quatre thématiques de l’IMT : l’industrie du futur responsable ; l’énergie, l’économie circulaire et la société ; l’ingénierie, la santé et le bien-être. IMT Mines Albi s’est dotée en 2023, pour une période quinquennale, d’un plan stratégique décliné en sept grandes actions, répondant aux orientations stratégiques du groupe IMT auquel elle appartient.

 

IMT Mines Albi représente :

  • 985 élèves-ingénieurs et chercheurs en formation ;

  • 300 personnels ;

  • un budget consolidé de 32 M€ ;

  • trois centres de formation et de recherche : Institut Clément Ader Albi (ICA-A), RAPSODEE et Centre Génie Industriel.

 

 

Le Centre Institut Clément Ader Albi (ICA-A) est un centre de formation et de recherche d’IMT Mines Albi. Il rassemble 70 personnes, dont 20 enseignants-chercheurs.

Au titre de la formation, il est un acteur de la formation ingénieur généraliste d’IMT Mines Albi, sous statut étudiant ou apprenti, et porte l’option « Matériaux et procédés avancés pour les transports de demain ».

 

Au titre de la recherche, il est partie intégrante de l’Institut Clément Ader (ICA – UMR CNRS 5312), laboratoire rassemblant 250 personnes et développant des thématiques scientifiques axées sur l’ingénierie et la mécanique des matériaux, notamment dans le domaine de l’aéronautique. Ses cinq établissements de tutelle sont l’INSA de Toulouse, l’ISAE-SUPAERO, l’Université Paul Sabatier, IMT Mines Albi et le CNRS.

 

Site Internet de l’ICA : https://ica.cnrs.fr/

 

L’ICA traite des études sur les structures, les systèmes et les processus mécaniques. Ses secteurs d’activité sont les industries mécaniques, avec un accent particulier sur l’aérospatiale, l’espace, le transport et l’énergie.

Le centre Institut Clément Ader Albi contribue aux quatre groupes de recherche de l’ICA :

  • Matériaux et Structures Composites ;

  • Surfaces, Usinage, Matériaux, Outillages ;

  • Métrologie, Identification, Contrôle, Surveillance ;

  • Modélisation des Systèmes et Microsystèmes Mécaniques.

 

Le champ d’action d’ICA-A est d’optimiser les outillages ou les procédés de mise en forme des matériaux (métaux, composites, polymères, verres, etc.) ainsi que d’étudier les relations entre microstructure, procédé et comportement, en particulier pour les secteurs de l’aéronautique et du spatial. Ses activités sont fortement expérimentales, mais également numériques.

 

ICA-A possède sa propre plateforme de recherche sur le campus d’IMT Mines Albi, la plateforme MIMAUSA. ICA-A est une Zone à Régime Restrictif (ZRR) depuis 2021.

 

DESCRIPTION DU POSTE :

De manière générale, la personne recrutée participera aux projets pédagogiques de l’école, aux missions de formation, aux activités de recherche et de transfert de technologies, au montage et au suivi des activités contractuelles ainsi qu’aux collaborations nationales et internationales. Elle contribuera activement au développement de ces activités et pourra être amenée à exercer des responsabilités administratives et d’encadrement.

 

La personne recrutée aura notamment vocation à assurer :

 

  • des responsabilités pédagogiques : responsable de cycle d’enseignement, responsable d’option, responsable de Master ou Mastère, responsable d’unité d’enseignement ;

  • et/ou des responsabilités en recherche : directeur de centre, directeur de centre adjoint, responsable de groupe de recherche, responsable d’axe de recherche, responsable de plateforme ;

  • et/ou des responsabilités liées au transfert industriel et au développement économique ;

  • et/ou des responsabilités transverses, comme par exemple : responsable de processus ou sous-processus, responsable thématique international.

 

Activités de formation

Dans le programme de formation du centre ICA-A, la personne recrutée participera aux activités pédagogiques et d’enseignement d’IMT Mines Albi.

 Dans ce cadre, elle sera amenée à :

  • contribuer à l’évolution des programmes pédagogiques et assurer des enseignements dans les domaines de l’analyse de données et de l’intelligence artificielle appliquées à l’écoconception, au développement de nouveaux matériaux, à leur mise en forme, ainsi qu’à l’étude de leurs mécanismes de dégradation et à la prévision de la durée de vie des pièces ;

  • accompagner et organiser les missions de formation de l’École sous leurs diverses formes : formation initiale ou continue, sous statut étudiant ou salarié, et formations débouchant sur des diplômes de Mastère ou de Master ;

  • participer au montage ou au pilotage de nouvelles formations (Mastère ou Master), prendre la responsabilité d’une ou plusieurs unités d’enseignement, s’impliquer dans l’organisation et le suivi de projets étudiants, ainsi que dans l’élaboration et l’exploitation de MOOC ;

  • encadrer des projets avec mises en situation, des stages et des travaux de fin d’études.

 

Activités de recherche

 Dans le programme de recherche du centre ICA-A, la personne recrutée :

  • proposera une démarche scientifique pour le développement de méthodes innovantes d’exploitation et d’analyse de données et d’utilisation de l’IA, capables de répondre aux exigences d’un dialogue essais/calcul multi-échelles. Ces méthodes seront utilisées pour le suivi ou la compréhension des propriétés des matériaux en lien avec leur fabrication ou avec le suivi de l’état de santé de pièces en service dans des environnements potentiellement critiques (hautes ou basses températures, contraintes mécaniques fortes, atmosphères oxydantes ou corrosives) ;

  • sera rattachée à un des groupes de recherche du laboratoire ICA (UMR 5312)

  • devra démontrer sa capacité à développer une activité contractuelle avec les entreprises et à participer au montage de chaires d’enseignement et de recherche en relation avec les entreprises ;

  • contribuera au rayonnement scientifique d’IMT Mines Albi et du laboratoire ICA par une implication active dans l’encadrement de thèses et de post-doctorants, par une production scientifique significative, par la diffusion de l’information scientifique lors de conférences et par l’organisation de manifestations scientifiques ;

  • sera amenée à monter des projets collaboratifs en lien avec les autres centres de recherche d’IMT Mines Albi : RAPSODEE et CGI.

 

 

Activités de valorisation et de développement économique

Dans le programme de valorisation et de développement économique du centre ICA-A, la personne recrutée devra :

  • renforcer le développement économique local et régional par l’accompagnement d’entités en incubation ou en prospection d’incubation au sein d’IMT Mines Albi ;

  • et/ou soutenir les initiatives ponctuelles en répondant aux demandes d’accompagnement (thèses CIFRE, contrats directs) formulées par les entreprises, en particulier les TPE et PME, dans son domaine d’expertise ;

  • et/ou accompagner la dynamique industrielle en s’impliquant dans la mise en place et le pilotage de chaires industrielles ou de laboratoires communs permettant d’optimiser le transfert technologique et méthodologique à destination des acteurs locaux, régionaux ou nationaux.

 

Évolution des responsabilités

À moyen terme, la personne recrutée pourra se voir proposer :

  • des responsabilités pédagogiques : responsable de cycle d’enseignement, responsable d’option, responsable de Master ou Mastère, responsable d’unité d’enseignement ;

  • et/ou des responsabilités en recherche : responsable de groupe de recherche, responsable d’axe de recherche, responsable de plateforme ;

  • et/ou des responsabilités liées au transfert industriel et au développement économique.

 

 

PROFIL RECHERCHE :

La personne candidate devra justifier d’une expérience d’au moins huit ans en recherche dans la spécialité Data/IA appliquée aux matériaux et procédés.

 

Une qualification aux fonctions de professeur en 60e section du CNU est fortement souhaitée.

 

En outre, la personne candidate devra :

 

  • présenter une expertise scientifique dans plusieurs des domaines suivants : jumeaux numériques, dynamique des systèmes, machine learning, deep learning, réseaux de neurones, deep optimisation ;

  • justifier d’expériences dans la conception et le pilotage de programmes pédagogiques ;

  • faire preuve d’une forte capacité et d’un goût prononcé pour l’animation d’une équipe de recherche ;

  • posséder de réelles qualités relationnelles, ainsi qu’un sens développé des relations humaines et des valeurs collectives ;

  • présenter une production scientifique cohérente avec les standards nationaux et internationaux et une expérience significative de l’encadrement doctoral.

 

AU-DELÀ DE L’ENVIRONNEMENT PROFESSIONNEL, POURQUOI NOUS REJOINDRE ? 

  • Un cadre de travail agréable sur un campus de 22 hectares ;

  • un forfait cadre avec 49 jours de congés annuels (congés + RTT) ;

  • le télétravail possible ;

  • une restauration administrative sur place ;

  • une aide à la mobilité durable pour les trajets domicile-travail ;

  • une action sociale (protection sociale complémentaire et aide aux familles) ;

  • une aide au déménagement ;

  • une aide à l’intégration sur le territoire : https://www.grand-albigeois.fr/entreprendre/creer-se-developper/soutien-au-recrutement-salarie/

 

INFORMATIONS COMPLÉMENTAIRES :

  • Statut : fonctionnaire ou détachement sur notre cadre de gestion.

  • À usage interne :

• Catégorie du poste et métier de référence : métier A – Professeur, Directeur d’études et Directeur de recherches

• Métier(s) de référence des agents pouvant postuler : toutes catégories

 

  • Localisation : Albi – IMT Mines Albi.

 

  • Date d’ouverture des candidatures : 1er octobre 2026.

  • Date limite de candidature : 1er novembre 2026.

  • Date de prise de fonction souhaitée : 1er janvier 2027.

 

Les postes offerts au recrutement sont ouverts à toutes et tous avec, sur demande, des aménagements pour les candidates et candidats en situation de handicap.

 

Contacts :

Sur le contenu du poste :
Mme Anaïs BARASINSKI – Directrice de Centre

Mme Marie GILLET – Responsable Recrutement et Développement des Compétences
 

Protection des données

Dans le cadre du règlement général sur la protection des données, les candidates et candidats sont informés que les données les concernant seront conservées par l’administration pendant une durée maximale de deux ans, sauf demande contraire de leur part précisée dans la lettre de motivation.
